description: View of two paintings on a gallery wall, Black Cross and a closeup of an interior of a flower. An image of a religious figure is visible in the adjoining room.
imageCaption: Alfred Stieglitz. Georgia O'Keeffe 27 New Paintings, New Mexico, New York, and Lake George, Interior Gallery View, 1930. Gelatin silver print, 3 3/8 x 7 11/16 inches. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation. [2006.6.1139]
title: Georgia O'Keeffe: 27 New Paintings, New Mexico, New York, Lake George, Etc., An American Place
